target_customer: Groups of friends, families and community leaders pooling capital into investment clubs, mostly real estate and private lending
problem: Co-investing in property needs expensive legal and back office work. Fractional supplies LLC setup, compliance, bookkeeping, distributions and tax filings for clubs.
business_model: SaaS and service fees per investment club
product_category: Group investing and real estate co-ownership infrastructure

founders.name: Stella Han
founders.background_notes: Inman 2021-11 says she and Treviño met while working at Affirm.

founders.name: Carlos Treviño
founders.background_notes: Their purchase of a property in Mexico with high legal fees prompted the idea per Inman.

technical_complexity.rationale: Entity formation, payments through Stripe, bank custody and tax reporting is standard fintech with legal structuring as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Club structure and community data create some lock-in, but the legal template and software are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copying documented; later fractional property platforms such as Arrived and Landa launched or raised in 2022.

market_need_then: Retail interest in real estate investing and group investing was high in 2021; the founders cite their own high legal costs; real estate venture funding hit a record in 2021 per PitchBook as reported by search results.

branding.domain_note: Uses fractional.app; legal entity is Fractional Homes Inc.

identity.visual_style: Simple, step by step, numbered chapters
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and community focused: Stop raising capital. Start building.

branding.community_and_virality: Celebrity angels Will Smith and Kevin Durant were named in 2021 funding coverage; club leaders featured on the site.

brand_strength.rationale: Celebrity investor press helped awareness, but the name is a generic term used by many fractional ownership companies.

pivots.from: Collaborative real estate co-investing for friends and strangers
pivots.to: Infrastructure for investment clubs and operators, asset agnostic
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; current site and 2024 coverage describe group investing clubs

outcome_analysis: Fractional raised a $5.5M seed at a reported $30M valuation in 2021-11 and a $15M Series A led by Fifth Wall in 2024-11, bringing total funding to about $20.55M. It is active and has moved toward serving operators who run investment clubs. No exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Seed valuation of $30M attributed to TechCrunch by Inman; second outlet check via search results from consumerstartups and Economy Solutions. The competitor list is empty because Arrived, Landa and Lofty sources found are dated 2022 or later, not near the batch. Another profile lists Krishna Mekala and Romuald Gillard as co-founders; unverified and not recorded. Team size conflict: YC says 10, a profile says about 38. The founded year is 2021 per Inman though YC says Winter 2021 batch and a Seedtable page says 2020.
